interactive.label: Add
interactive.tooltip: Append a component with the model of the selected one; it can then be edited independently.

interactive.label: Remove
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected component. One component always stays.

interactive.label: weight
interactive.tooltip: Mixing weight of the selected component (normalised across the components).

interactive.label: Input curves
interactive.tooltip: Load or unload measured IRF, background and correction curves for this model.

interactive.label: Donor reference
interactive.tooltip: Open a donor-only fit or register a lifetime working model to populate the reference list.

interactive.label: Remove subcomponent
interactive.tooltip: Remove the last donor component; one stays.

interactive.label: Remove subcomponent
interactive.tooltip: Remove the last distances component; one stays.

interactive.label: Remove subcomponent
interactive.tooltip: Remove the last rotations component; one stays.

interactive.label: Model settings
interactive.tooltip: Scalar settings that define the model's topology and numerical evaluation.

interactive.label: Add FRET line
interactive.tooltip: Compute the current mixture and sweep and add it as a new line. Press repeatedly to overlay several lines.

interactive.label: Save CSV
interactive.tooltip: Save all computed lines to one CSV file (line, sweep, parameter, τ_F, τ_X, E per point).

interactive.label: Push to ndX
interactive.tooltip: Overlay all computed lines on ndX. ndX takes tabulated lines from other tools only when the host gives this window a connection; without one a notice says so.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain static, dynamic, WLC and mixture FRET lines.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through a static line and a two-state dynamic line.
